description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) UMBRAL EVASION (1 CP) in the OPPONENT's Shooting phase — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The Ork player selects the Flash Gitz and targets the Infiltrator Squad (PHOBOS) (ASSIGN_TARGET + Confirm Targets); the defender's reactive dialog (enemy_targets_unit_shooting) offers the stratagem; a REAL click spends 1 CP; ranged attacks that target the unit have -1 to hit (this phase).
